changes_made.explanation: Consolidated and cleaned up the guideline descriptions. Added criteria based on the manual analysis objectives described in the paper section analyzing verbalized vs raw tables impact on ODQA.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on data-to-text generation as a means for encoding structured knowledge for open-domain QA. The NLG evaluation is primarily intrinsic (automatic metrics) with some downstream extrinsic evaluation via QA performance. The human evaluation is limited to manual analysis of system behavior rather than comprehensive output quality assessment. The extraction was generally accurate but needed some normalization and removal of non-NLG components.
